table.name: TLGNC_ORDER_REP_MAINT_TYPE
table.description: Stores the selected maintenance/repair types for a repair/maintenance order. Typically the entries are generated by the application (for automatic maintenance orders) but can be created/modified manually by the user as well.

column.name: ORDER_REP_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_order_rep. The repair/maintenance order to which this maint type selection belongs to.

column.name: MAINT_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_maint_type_cd. The maintenance (including repair) type of this selection.
